title: Push
notConfigured: Push is not configured on this deployment (PUSH_VAPID_* keys): PWAs do not ask for notifications and broadcasts cannot be sent.

broadcasts.emptyDescription: Send a notification to the subscribers of your installed PWAs.
broadcasts.cancelDescription: It will not be sent. Nothing has gone out yet.

form.title: New broadcast
form.description: Goes to every active subscriber the filters match — now, at the time you schedule, or to each new subscriber some time after they subscribe.
form.name: Name
form.bodyPlaceholder: Open the app to claim it before Sunday.
form.iconHint: https only. Empty: the PWA's icon.
form.imageHint: https only, optional. Not every browser shows it.
form.targetDestinationHint: The destination their install click was routed to — conversions stay on that click.
form.confirmDescription_one: It goes to {{count}} subscriber right away and cannot be recalled.
form.confirmDescription_other: It goes to {{count}} subscribers right away and cannot be recalled.

validation.name: 2–100 characters
validation.title: 1–80 characters
validation.sendAt: Pick a time from a minute to 30 days ahead
validation.delay: 5 minutes to 30 days, a whole number

form.confirmDescription_few: It goes to {{count}} subscribers right away and cannot be recalled.
form.confirmDescription_many: It goes to {{count}} subscribers right away and cannot be recalled.
form.sendAtHint: The audience is counted when it goes out: subscribers who join before then get it too.
form.confirmScheduleDescription_one: It goes out {{when}} to the subscribers matching then — {{count}} today. You can cancel it until then.
form.confirmScheduleDescription_other: It goes out {{when}} to the subscribers matching then — {{count}} today. You can cancel it until then.
form.triggerHint: Only people who subscribe from now on get it — current subscribers are not included. The condition is checked when it is sent; a subscriber not reached within 24 hours of their time (the trigger was paused) is skipped.
form.confirmTriggerDescription: Each new subscriber matching the filters gets it {{trigger}}. You can pause it any time.

stats.bySendDay: Each delivery counts on the day it went out (a trigger spreads over the days it sends); its later opens stay with it.
